source_text: Sicut dixi Moysi, eremum et Antilibanum usque ad flumen magnum Euphraten. Eremum Deus subiecit Iesu — deserta de quibus: Laetare eremus sitiens, et: Multi filii desertae magis quam eius quae habet virum. Non dixit Libanum sed Antilibanum. Si videas priorem populum secundum carnem Israel qui erat vera oliva, ipsum intellige Libanum verum; sed cum pro incredulitate auferatur ab eo regnum et detur genti facienti fructum, istum populum Antilibanum senti — ecclesia Dei vivi ex gentibus congregata per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum, cui est gloria et imperium in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: As I-said unto-Moses, desert and Antilibanus as-far-as unto river great Euphrates. Desert God subjected unto-Jesus — deserts concerning which: Rejoice desert thirsting, and: Many sons of-desert more than of-her who has husband. Not he-said Libanus but Antilibanus. If you-see former people according-to flesh Israel who was true olive, him understand Libanus true; but when for unbelief is-taken from him kingdom and is-given unto-nation doing fruit, that people Antilibanus perceive — church of-God living from nations gathered through Jesus Christ Lord our, unto-whom is glory and dominion into ages of-ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[As I said to Moses: the desert and this Antilibanus as far as the great river, the river Euphrates >> Bible:Joshua 1:3-4]]. God subjected the desert to Jesus — the deserts of which the prophet says: [[Rejoice, O thirsting desert >> Bible:Isaiah 35:1]] and [[More are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband >> Bible:Isaiah 54:1]]. He did not say Lebanon but Antilibanus — “over-against Lebanon.” If you see that former people according to the flesh, Israel, who was the [[true olive >> Bible:Romans 11:24]], understand him as the true Lebanon; but when for unbelief [[the kingdom is taken from him and given to a nation producing its fruit >> Bible:Matthew 21:43]], perceive that incoming people as Antilibanus — [[the church of the living God >> Bible:1 Timothy 3:15]] gathered from the nations through Jesus Christ our Lord, [[to whom be glory and dominion forever. Amen >> Bible:1 Peter 5:11]].
